title: Relatively useless in free version on Mac
body: Free version doesn’t let you connect to a Mac server, so you can’t test it out with a local Docker install. Why have an app in the macOS App Store whose free/demo version only works if you have a Linux Docker server to talk to? Most of us, I think, would want to try this out in a local environment before deciding whether to buy.

title: Fails to connect through domain
body: I've allowed remote access to my server and can log in from any web browser, however this app can't seem to log in that way. Even checked the docs and their explanation was "The server does not answer in time. Please check if your server allows the incoming connection", which is odd since I can log in from the same device. Shame.

title: It Works
body: I just didn’t find any use for it. If you’re running self hosted docker containers just self host one that does everything this does because there are plenty of options out there.

title: Seems great
body: I haven't got deep into it yet, but so far, it's been flawless. I dropped a star because it's running on a Mac, but the free/demo version doesn't support Mac... only Linux. I suggest that for the free version, you allow one, or the other, but not both. Not everyone has a Linux instance they can use to test this with. Now if you'll excuse me, I have to go add my MacBook as a server in the app...

title: Great App
body: Does almost everything I want! Good privacy profile as well; western dev with a track record at this point. Lots of similar apps that originate in China, occasionally going to great lengths to mask that fact. These are all potential security issues; apps like these hand sensitive SSH credentials over. Must trust the vendor. I do kind of wish this had a SSH terminal built in but who am I kidding, I’d just ask Codex to fix whatever is going on anyway.

title: Great Tool!
body: We now use this daily to monitor servers.

title: Very good
body: Very good docker and server manager. Beautiful ui, easy to sort out and quick easy ways to make changes. Works great on all Mac devices and connects well to various os including qnap qts. Great value, would love snippets next A+

title: Great application works well
body: Works well with QNAP. Easy to setup, and manage docker containers quickly. Very nice UI and love that I can manage everything from any mac device. Responsive Dev, and great security. Is there snippets support?

title: Intuitive interface, faster than other apps
body: I tried a few other docker admin apps and am really impressed by this one. The interface is intuitive and gives you the option to dock floating panels so you can see your favorite containers on the main screen.

title: Works great with my Linux docker host
body: Super easy to get started. Has everything I needed to quickly manage my server
